verdict.line: You lose when you walk into her empowered Q1/Q2 poke chain before level 3; you win when your parry lands and you convert with Lunge resets before her Hookshot resets.

brief.thesis: Camille's 325-range Precision Protocol (Q) lets her poke and disengage for free before Fiora hits her level 3-5 spike, which is why the head-to-head sits at 46.3% over 164 games despite Fiora holding the raw lane and solo-kill advantage. This is an execution matchup: Riposte (W) timing against her empowered auto and dodging the delayed Q2 burst decide almost every all-in, not raw stats.

theirWindow.when: when she delays her Q recast
theirWindow.what: If she lands Q1 and holds the recast, the follow-up auto does significantly increased bonus damage. Back off and let the recast expire before you commit to a trade.

yourWindow.when: when her Hookshot (E) is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Hookshot is her only escape and engage tool at 16/15/14/13/12s cooldown. If it's down, dive with Lunge (Q) and its free second dash — she has no way to reset the fight or reposition off a wall.

start.why: Run 93.2% of the time (49.2% win rate, 179 games) because the sustain and AD offset her Q1/Q2 poke chain before you have W to punish her attacks.

boots.why: 73.6% pick rate at 47.5% win rate over 120 games — she wants to whittle you down with basic-attack-based Q and the outer half of W, and Steelcaps flatten both.

core.why: First item in the 34.4%-picked, 60.6%-winning path — the sustain and cleave keep you healthy through her poke phase while scaling your Lunge damage.
Second in the same path — the damage spike here is where Fiora starts winning extended trades outright by levels 9-13.
Closes out the highest-winning build (60.6% over 33 games) and lets you survive her R (Hextech Ultimatum) burst window while your passive heals catch up.

situational.when: you're ahead and want to shield through her Q1/Q2 burst on your all-in
the lane stalls and you want to threaten split-push since her Hookshot needs walls to reposition
you need extra sustain against her W healing on top of Death's Dance

runes.keystoneWhy: The most-run page (10.9% pick, 55% win rate) — PTA's stacking punishes Camille's habit of resetting Q autos on you, since three hits mark and burst her before her passive shield window resets.

summoners.why: Run 89.7% of the time (46.7% win rate) — Ignite cuts the healing from her Tactical Sweep (W) outer-half hit and closes out the trade windows this matchup is decided by.

playing.title: Hold Riposte for her Q1
playing.detail: Don't burn W on a random poke auto. Save it for the moment she commits to an all-in — parrying reflects magic damage back and denies the trade she planned around.

playing.title: Don't walk into 325 range for free
playing.detail: Precision Protocol only has 325 range. Stay outside it between waves and only step in when you're ready to trade, since every free auto she lands stacks toward a delayed Q2 burst.

playing.title: Skill max QWEQQRQ per the standard order
playing.detail: Follow the 56.1%-picked QWEQQRQEQEREEWW order — E stays at rank 1 until level 5-6 so W stays available for parry timing every fight.

playing.title: Fight when her shield window is down
playing.detail: Her passive only shields after a basic attack lands, on a brief duration. The measured data flags this as the single highest-value engage window even when your parry doesn't fully negate the trade.

playing.title: Track Hookshot before all-in
playing.detail: If she's out of wall range or Hookshot is down (16-12s cooldown by rank), she has no disengage. That's your green light to commit with Lunge's free second dash.

playing.title: Respect the R timer only past level 11
playing.detail: Hextech Ultimatum drops to a 90s cooldown at rank 3 and stays near-zero recast after — from level 11 on, assume it's up far more often than yours and play around her initiating, not you.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, summoner spells, and all win rates above are measured OP.GG data from current-patch games; the mechanical reasoning — parry timing, poke ranges, and power-spike windows — is my own tactical read of the kits.

stats.opponentTip: You will have the upper hand if your [W] manages to stun Camille even if it does not block her (W). Fight her while aiming for [P].
